method: Four original tactile coastal variations of the approved Critical Mass composition. No external samples.

tracks.title: Critical Mass / Shorebreak
tracks.direction: Closest to the approved track: punchy breakbeat, warm elastic bass, hollow plastic lead and coastal air

tracks.title: Critical Mass / Candy Current
tracks.direction: Glossy candy identity: thick glass-resonator hook, rubbery low end and clacking tactile percussion

tracks.title: Critical Mass / Tidal Pressure
tracks.direction: Ocean mayhem: deeper bass, weighty drums, muted metallic hook and wave-like swells

tracks.title: Critical Mass / Sunlit Chaos
tracks.direction: Warmer island energy: plucked string body, wide airy chords and syncopated hand percussion
